principles.title: Code decides the numbers, AI explains them
principles.detail: Allocation percentages and dollar amounts always come from deterministic rules; the LLM only narrates what the rules already computed.

principles.title: Every number is checked against a sourced Fact before it's shown
principles.detail: Each figure in an explanation or answer is matched against the Facts list and rejected or regenerated if it doesn't match.

principles.title: Nothing after the simulation date is ever visible
principles.detail: Prices, rates, and news are clipped to the current simulated date so the demo never leaks future information.

principles.title: Guardrails block questions outside the plan's scope
principles.detail: Off-topic or unsafe questions are filtered before they ever reach the LLM, and the block is logged to the audit trail.

principles.title: Every step is logged to an audit trail
principles.detail: Parses, builds, checks, and answers all emit an audit event so the pipeline behind any shown number can be traced.
